scope.dates: Author prototype design names May 19. This independently completed 24-hour cohort uses a UTC+08:00 calendar, starts flat at 10,000 USDT and keeps terminal positions marked. The original six-month author screenshot is for an older revision.
scope.model: Current official FMZ local WASM supports generated tick mode. 200 ms default latency, 1d chart, 5m base, zero slippage, and author settings of 0.008% maker/0.01% taker. The local scope uses depth 5 and disabled fault injection. The author screenshot contains depth 20 and tolerance field 0.1. No historical order-book fills are claimed.
scope.settlement: Closed reductions are counted individually and funded amounts are allocated to average-price inventory. Independently validates all modeled fills against official bar ranges, native resting status, fees and P&L, and both funding rates against official index and mark ranges.
scope.limitations: May 19 provides one stress scenario for execution risk. The study does not estimate median performance. Open long drawdown materially changes the result relative to closed trade win rate.
